invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破90.5（新止损位），或融资费率Z-score转负（空头风险），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 86.11）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 90.5 (new stop-loss), or funding Z-score turns negative (short risk), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 86.11).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2100（基于ATR 18.88和支撑位），或融资费率Z-score转正（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2042.03）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2100 (based on ATR 18.88 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2042.03).
